issues.on_page: Local 773,189 (p4) = Charges for services 447,257 + Interest income 192,725 + Miscellaneous 133,207 (Statement of Activities, p2)
issues.issue: [fixed: recategorized with review note] Local is recorded as 'other', but p2 shows what it is: mostly charges for services (58%), plus interest and miscellaneous. These three figures add up to the line exactly. Under the rules, 'other' is only for lines with nothing on the page that explains them, and a mixed line takes its dominant category (charges for services/fees) plus a review note. Splitting it with split_from, the same way Taxes was split, would also be defensible.
